description: Order template (order class OrderTemplates, OT- number) with at least one line, of the declared account that owns between min and max templates on the store. Outputs: templateName, templateNumber, quantity, templateCount. Read only. KB: Order Templates.

owner.description: ZnodeUser.UserId of the account that owns the order template: link it to the test's declared account (@user.userId), never a username. Left out (verification only): any owner

minTemplates.description: Order templates the account must own on the store (at least)

maxTemplates.description: Most templates allowed, e.g. the page size so all fit one page. Left out: no upper bound

store.description: Store code the webstore under test serves (ZnodePortal.StoreCode)
